div.div: 4 اطفقهُ ٱللّٰهُ بِهِ God caused him to attain him, or it. (Aboo-Sa'eed, O, K.) One says, لَئِنْ أَطْفَقَنِى ٱللّٰهُ بِهِ لَأَفْعَلَنَّ بِهِ [Verily if God cause me to attain him, or it, I will assuredly do something with him, or it]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
